verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform documents its own API, but the evidence describes only a narrow scope: listing deployments, gathering findings and listing projects. Nothing shows parity with UI actions such as triage, policy and rule management, or settings, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage for triage/ticketing/policy/rule management/settings, a published OpenAPI spec or full API reference, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Semgrep AppSec Platform provides an API that enables you to list deployments, gather findings created by Semgrep AppSec Platform, and list projects.
